column1: # The long catalogue screens whose text is the game's own, taken from the package's WCCMMUD.DLL
# at import (crates/silvermere-import/src/dll_text.rs). One line per catalogue key, tab
# separated: the key, the SHA-256 of the DLL bytes the parts name (in order), then the parts,
# space separated. A part `OFFSET+LENGTH` is that many bytes of the DLL from that offset (CP437
# text, `\r` line ends); any other part is template text kept as written, here only the ANSI
# macros (`{@ANSI_WHITE}`) the catalogue writes where the game printed a colour of its own.
# None of these entries takes an argument.
